summary.prose: Building this Story teaches the VS Code extension about the Claude-on-Ollama runner. The plugin's view of the daemon's definitions gains the host and hosting marks; the 'insrc: Set model tier' picker then labels that runner's models cloud or local, drops the 'enter another id' path for it and says plainly when a configured model will not run; and the native tier settings refuse an unlisted model for it with the right reason. Today's runners keep their current picker items and messages.

tasks.title: host/hosting on the plugin's definitions types; host-aware tier picker
tasks.summary: vscode-plugin/src/models/definitions.ts: DefinedFamily gains host?: 'ollama' and DefinedModel gains hosting?: 'cloud' | 'local'. vscode-plugin/src/models/model-tier-picker.ts: modelDescription adds the model's hosting to its marks; pickModel adds 'Enter another model id…' only for a family with a cliKind and no host, and lists a current model a host family does not declare as '(current, not supported — the tier will not run): <id>' with 'not supported by <displayName>'. Vendor and plain Ollama families unchanged. Tests in vscode-plugin/src/models/__tests__/model-tier-picker.test.ts over a fake answer with a host family.
acceptanceChecks: The family step offers the host family next to today's families; picking it lists only its declared models, each with 'cloud' or 'local' among its marks, plus Refresh and no 'Enter another model id…'.
A host model with efforts offers '' plus its own levels; one with none skips the effort step; the pick writes the whole tier once.

A configured undeclared model on the host family is listed as '(current, not supported — the tier will not run)'; a vendor family keeps '(current, not listed — runs the default)' and 'Enter another model id…'.
An answer without host (older daemon) shows no marks and offers 'Enter another model id…' for that CLI family.
Reopening the picker after a save marks the saved family, model (with its mark) and effort as current; an effort the model does not take shows as the CLI default.
model-tier-picker.ts names no runner or model literal (the existing literal-scan test stays green).

tests.name: model-tier-picker.test.ts: the host family is offered next to today's; its models carry cloud/local marks, no 'Enter another model id', efforts only where the model has them, one whole-tier write
model-tier-picker.test.ts: an undeclared current model on the host family is 'not supported — the tier will not run'; a vendor family and a host-less answer keep today's items
model-tier-picker.test.ts: reopening the picker after a save on the host family marks the saved family, model and effort as current

tasks.title: Settings sync refuses an undeclared host-family model with the 'only listed' reason; tier setting descriptions
tasks.summary: vscode-plugin/src/config/sync-engine.ts applyTier: an undeclared model on a family with a host is refused with "insrc: '<model>' is not a listed <displayName> model; only listed <displayName> models can be used (<ids>) — <tier> tier not changed" and every changed key reverted; vendor CLI families keep the 'check and approve it' message. vscode-plugin/scripts/sync-manifest-catalog.mjs TIER_NOTE says (naming no family) that a family running its CLI on Ollama accepts only its listed models; vscode-plugin/package.json regenerated with npm run sync-manifest. Tests in vscode-plugin/src/config/__tests__/sync-engine.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: Setting a model the host family does not declare is refused with the 'only listed <family> models can be used (<ids>)' reason, every changed key is reverted and nothing is written to the daemon.
A vendor CLI family's unlisted model keeps the 'run insrc: Set model tier to check and approve it' message, and so does the same family in an answer without host (older daemon).

Setting only the runner to the host family writes its first declared model with effort '' as the whole tier and mirrors it into the native model/effort keys; a declared model given by alias is written with the canonical id.
An effort the declared host model does not take is refused as today and reverted.
A daemon refusal of the host-family write (ok:false) reverts every changed key with 'daemon rejected the <tier> tier — <reason>'.
The tier setting descriptions in package.json match the regenerated TIER_NOTE (sync-manifest --check passes) and name no family, model or effort.

tests.name: sync-engine.test.ts: an undeclared model for the host family is refused with 'only listed models can be used' and reverted; a vendor or host-less family keeps 'check and approve it'; a daemon refusal reverts

sync-engine.test.ts: a runner-only switch to the host family writes its first declared model as the whole tier and mirrors the native keys; an alias is written canonically; an effort the model does not take is refused
